marker: # unit_length, ref_repeats and the Mu50 amplicon (ref_size) are all published. unit and ref_repeats
# are Table 1 of Pourcel et al. 2009, which gives the repeat unit length and the copy number in the
# reference strain Mu50 (ATCC 700699); ref_size is the product these primers give in the Mu50
# assembly GCA_000009665.1, and it equals the amplicon size Bogut et al. 2024 (Table 2) report for
# every one of the 14 loci. A run on Mu50 returns the published profile 10-6-3-4-6-7-4-5-3-3-3-5-4-2
# with a residual of zero at every locus.
# No repeat unit sequences are published, so patterns is N/A throughout and the allele is computed
# from amplicon length. The scheme was cross-checked against the 31 clinical profiles of Bogut et al.
# Table 3: of 66 panel 1 cells, 57 reproduce the published allele exactly, and the nine that differ
# do so by less than one repeat, consistent with that study sizing its amplicons on agarose gels
# while this scheme measures them exactly in an assembly. coa (Sa0266) carries a half-repeat
# polymorphism, so some strains give an n.5 allele there, as Bogut Table 3 shows; those are real
# alleles of that locus rather than uncertain calls.
# Several loci are STAR elements or SIRU loci, families of short intergenic repeats: Sa0311, Sa1729,
# Sa1866, Sa0906 and Sa1213 are STAR elements, and Sa0122 (spa), Sa1291 and Sa1756 carry SIRU
# numbers. Sa0122 is the protein A repeat region, so this panel is not independent of spa typing,
# nor of the two loci saureus_mlva8_schouls_2009 shares with it, VNTR24_01 (= Sa0122) and VNTR63_01
# (= Sa1132), which were anchored to this panel's Mu50 counts.
